subject: Default 5 s timeouts in apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-copy.test.ts and production-reobserve.test.ts under host load
beforeCommit: fd8d1a2^ (origin/main at the bead's rebase, both files unmodified)

fix.polaris-copy.test.ts: Cheaper fixture: the twelve variant models are built once in beforeAll (hook timeout 60 s) and deep-frozen, instead of being rebuilt per test (up to twenty builds per test). No assertion changed.
fix.production-reobserve.test.ts: Explicit per-test timeout PRODUCTION_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000 on the three tests that each run two full production builds over the real tree; no cheaper fixture keeps what they test. Comment names the measured worst case (18.0 s, before) and this bead. Global testTimeout unchanged; nothing skipped or retried.

protocol.aloneRuns: npx vitest run <file> --reporter=json, 5 times per file
protocol.fullRuns: npx vitest run --project @syzygy/three-surface-poc-app --reporter=json, measured run concurrent with one companion full app-project run (parallel-load protocol), alongside the other overnight lane's real load; load1m sampled at each run's end
protocol.timeoutClassifier: an assertion is a timeout when its failure message starts 'Error: STACK_TRACE_ERROR' (vitest replaces the timeout error's message with its stackTraceError) or contains 'timed out in'. Rule-6 check: with the classifier returning only the 'timed out in' arm, the before data reports 0 timeouts instead of 18, so the STACK_TRACE_ERROR arm is load-bearing.
protocol.harness: scratch scripts measure.sh and build_evidence.py (not committed); raw vitest JSON reports retained in the session scratchpad only

result.statement: After: 10 consecutive full app-project runs under the parallel-load protocol; 110 in-scope test executions (10 runs x 11 tests in the two files), 0 timeouts, 0 failures; companion runs also 0 in-scope timeouts. Before: 3 runs, 33 executions, 18 timeouts (all six heavy tests in every run).

outOfScopeFailures: Failures in other files are recorded per run under fullRuns[].measured.otherFailures and fullRuns[].companion.otherFailures; not fixed by this bead. After: governance-inputs.test.ts 'evaluates the three real current PWB acts' timed out in all 10 measured runs; build-output.test.ts failed in runs 1 and 5 (one timeout), durable-lifecycle.test.ts timed out in run 1, and draft-preview.browser.test.ts failed in run 1 (not a timeout). project-shape-discovery.live.test.ts is skipped, not failed.

rule6.note: No assertion predicate was added or changed. The hoist adds two guards; each has a recorded mutant. The production-reobserve timeout is a value, not a predicate: its removal is the before state, measured above.

mutants.predicate: deepFreeze rejects a write to a shared variant model
evidence: TypeError: Cannot add property asOf, object is not extensible

mutants.predicate: control for M1: the same write with deepFreeze removed is not caught (the freeze is the only guard)
modelFor refuses a variant the beforeAll did not build
